note: What a server sends about a camp of units that belong to no side. Both payloads observed name a camp with nothing credited for it and no time for its return, one of them for a camp that had just filled, so whether it marks a camp emptied is not settled here.

fields.name: killer
fields.note: The unit credited with emptying it. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: timerKind
fields.note: Which clock the client shows for it.

fields.name: returnsAt
fields.note: When the camp fills again, in seconds. Zero in everything observed.

bits.name: speak
bits.note: Set where the client says something about it. Set in everything observed.
